text.flow-layout.spec.ts: Checks in a real Chromium that the Flow rows and file chips wrap inside the narrowest right pane without overflowing, that a picked step keeps its amber border and glow while hovered, and that reading steps get a badge while the rest is greyed; skips when no Chromium can be launched
text.graph-macro-areas.spec.ts: Checks in the real app that the Macro view opens on the areas map with no layout to choose, enters one with a double-click and leaves it with Escape, Backspace or the breadcrumb, goes sideways to another area from the panel and keeps the entered area across Files, and that a pull request lights the areas it touches and the reading marker moves between areas while stepping.
text.graph-macro-systems.spec.ts: Checks on the evaluation project at 1600 by 1000 and 1280 by 800 that the outside systems list is always there under the map with every system and its count, filters to what a clicked block talks to with Show all, lights every area and foundation entry that talks to a clicked system with counts and a side panel grouped by area and feature, is cleared by a second click or Escape, never clips text, and can be driven with the keyboard; saves screenshots.
text.graph-macroview.spec.ts: Drives the areas map in the real app on three projects at two window sizes: every area fits above the outside systems list, no page scroll or zoom, marks at the right zoom, keys, wheel, breadcrumb, the Macro view mounting once, and screenshots.
text.graph-macro-foundation.spec.ts: Checks in the real app, on the evaluation project, that selecting a foundation tile lists what it uses and where its platform has files and lights its partners on the areas map, and that an area shows its platforms.
text.graph-macro-legend.spec.ts: Checks in the real app that the Macro legend is short, fits the side panel, and that its swatches (selected, uses, To assign) are painted exactly like the shapes on the map, and screenshots the areas map and flat keys.
text.graph-macro-platform-uses.spec.ts: Checks in the real app that of two bots of one kind the accounts area is lit strongly for the one with files there and as uses for the one that only uses it, with the legend drawing it the same solid way, lists both in the side panel, lights nothing as uses at rest and screenshots each.
text.graph-macro.spec.ts: Checks the macro view in the real canvas: the counts drawn at rest, readable names, selection, Escape and the way back to the file graph.
text.graph-navigation.spec.ts: Checks graph zoom, panning, right-drag, overscroll, focus and input behaviour in Electron
text.graph-performance.spec.ts: Measures large-graph startup, selection latency and renderer resource baselines
text.graph-pixi.spec.ts: Checks WebGL rendering, retained tile text across zoom, interaction and failure recovery
text.graph-regression.spec.ts: Guards graph appearance, selection, search and empty states against regressions
text.tray-popover.spec.ts: Drives the menu bar popover in its harness with synthetic projects in every state: urgency order, a long name and path, nothing needing you, the empty state, the More panel with and without notifications, arrow keys, Enter and Escape, pointer selection, a live update, a scrolling list, the stopped spinner when motion is reduced and the header logo in the app icon's colours at 1x and 2x.
text.skills-extras.spec.ts: Drives the Lantern skills tab in Electron over real files: the role selector, scope badges, search, attach with a click and with Enter, moving between scopes, detaching with Delete, the project file kept out of git, the narrow stacked layout and the main window with only the global scope, and captures screenshots when asked
text.integrations-bindings.spec.ts: Adds three accounts of each provider to the Integrations harness and walks two projects and a brand-new one with no origin remote through choosing, re-choosing while pinned, unlinking and reopening the dialog, a Bitbucket account chosen on a GitHub project, an account the environment shadows, plus the button that jumps from the accounts to the projects and the status bar icon naming the chosen account
text.integrations.spec.ts: Drives the Integrations dialog, opened from its button, at 1280x800 and 700x640 through the real IPC against a stub provider server: adding and refusing tokens, two accounts of one provider, the project tile grid and its detail step with twelve projects, a project's account choice, expiry warnings, removing, a provider icon in the status bar that reopens the dialog on its project, and no cut-off text or file-token wording
text.lsp-semantic.spec.ts: Checks real semantic highlighting through production preload and IPC in code and diff previews
text.pr-host-state.spec.ts: Loads the pull requests of a GitHub-origin project through the production host status against a stub API and checks the strip shows the open, the squash-merged and the declined one as the host reports them, saving screenshots on request
text.pr-review-demo.spec.ts: Exercises ordered PR review across the file list, the file and diff pane and the graph
text.pr-review-layout.spec.ts: Checks the three review panes fit a laptop window and that the dividers move by keyboard and pointer
text.text-select.spec.ts: Checks in a real Chromium that the readable review and Flow text computes to selectable while the chrome stays unselectable, and that a drag-select on a Flow step does not pick it; skips when no Chromium can be launched
text.tsconfig.json: Configures type checking for browser tests and their production dependencies
text.pr-review-explain.spec.ts: Checks in a real Chromium that the Explain panel shows its four sections and that collapsing it with the keyboard gives the file view its height back
text.pr-review-regions.spec.ts: Checks at 1280x800 that hiding each review area gives its width to the rest with no horizontal overflow, that the last of viewer and graph stays, and that the layout is remembered per project and reset
text.pane-overflow.spec.ts: Drags both review dividers to their extremes at 1280x800 and 1600x1000, also with a saved comment card, a file comment and an open comment box, and fails when text is cut off at a pane edge or the graph is wider than its pane, including the areas map with the outside systems list for a picked system and a picked area
text.pr-review-comments.spec.ts: Comments on diff lines and on the whole file in the real app, checks the card sits under its line, copies the comments, keeps them over a reload, covers the gutter drag, edit, fold and delete, and marks a comment as a question and copies a mixed set and then an all-question set
